We adopt the Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) to implement the text decoder. For the MedCLIPScore, we set $w$ to 2.5, and threshold $\tau$ to 0.75 (Hessel et al., 2021). For model training, we follow the Noisy Student self-training framework (Xie et al., 2020) to inject the input noise and model noise to enhance the robustness and performance of the model. For parameters optimization, we adopt the AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019) with a learning rate of 1e-4 and a batch size of 16. We apply a beam search of size 3 for inference.
